cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
줄파락 풀파 완료!
주특입 맞지? 출발하자!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle medium shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with only a minimal sandy Zul'Farrak stone step under their feet. On the left, Orc Warrior tank holds a compact one-handed battle axe and sturdy steel shield with an excited grin. On the right, Troll Shaman (totem staff stowed on back) pumps one fist cheerfully beside her.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
저 장트라제 만들 거라
도검 뜨면 입찰할게요
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile two-shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal sandy ground shadows. On the left, Undead Paladin as Holy healer (weapon stowed on back) casually raises one empty hand with sleepy half-lidded deadpan eyes. On the right, Orc Warrior tank holding her compact one-handed axe and sturdy steel shield freezes mid-step in utter bewilderment.

equip_effects: 사용 효과: 장트라제와 상트라제를 결합하여 강력한 검 술트라제를 만듭니다.
발동 효과: 사용자를 보호막으로 감싸 55에서 85의 물리 피해를 흡수합니다. 20초 동안 지속됩니다.

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
아니 님 힐러 신기잖아!
근딜 합체검을 왜 굴려?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dutch-tilt diagonal reaction shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Troll Shaman (staff stowed on back) leans forward wide-eyed with flying sweat drops, waving both empty hands in disbelief. On the right, Undead Paladin (weapon stowed on back) stands completely unbothered with arms crossed and a blank sleepy expression.

Extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Orc Warrior on the left and Troll Shaman on the right freeze side-by-side from shoulders up with tiny blank dot pupils, pale shocked faces, and crisp icy blue chill swirls floating around them in dead silence.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.visual_prompt: Tight low-angle solo medium shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Centered, Undead Paladin (weapon stowed on back) calmly holds out a tiny tied brown leather coin pouch with a couple of shiny round gold coins peeking out, wearing a totally dry sleepy deadpan face.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
힐러가 칼 굴리는 팟을
탱이 왜 감? 걍 파탈함
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle wide back-view comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal sandy ground touch. On the left, Orc Warrior (compact axe and steel shield strapped on back) marches briskly away holding a smooth oval hearthstone with a glowing cyan spiral rune and a fed-up scowl. On the right, Troll Shaman (staff stowed) waves frantically after her with empty hands.
